svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Cut with a long bread knife or a fine saw; wear gloves, a dust mask

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and glasses. Foil face toward the stack.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side pieces 1,050 x 52.5 mm; high piece 1,000 x 52.5 mm with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: same five openings as the high wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Low end: ten blocks 33 mm tall that fill the spaces between the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: low wall's notches (the end ones stop 15 mm short of each side,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for the stop blocks), and a cap piece 1,000 x 19.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drawn: the right half, cap lifted 30 mm; the left is a mirror image.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue each piece to its wall with high-temperature silicone.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pockets: cut a 30 mm hole 10 mm deep behind the pivot and prop

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hinge holes in the side pieces for the nut and washer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the foil face is unbroken except at the openings.
